annotations.title: A/B test sample size and significance

description: Plan how many visitors a test needs to detect a lift, or check whether a finished test's difference is real. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

alpha.description: False-alarm risk (significance level). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

baseline.description: Current conversion rate. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

lift.description: Smallest relative lift worth detecting. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

mode.description: What do you need?. Use matching records and scope.

nA.description: Version A visitors. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

nB.description: Version B visitors. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

power.description: Chance of detecting a real lift (power). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

sides.description: Test direction. Use matching records and scope.

traffic.description: Visitors or offers per day (both versions together). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

xA.description: Version A conversions. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

xB.description: Version B conversions. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.
